items.content_html: This project studies how different visual encoders affect the performance of a latent world model for action-conditioned prediction and planning. Using DINO-WM as the backbone, we keep the transition model and planning pipeline as fixed as possible, and compare representations such as DINOv2, V-JEPA 2, DINOv3, DINO-Tok, and VFM-VAE.
